cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make Them Your Deputy
cards.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I need help running the raffle. I've made you a deputy badge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Because I need help, not a second direction.

mechanism: A secures raffle help as a subordinate ticket role, using exact procedure and quality checks to reserve direction and decisions to A.
confusable: S03 expertise alone could be collaborative; D49 requires defining the helper role as service under A rather than shared control.
comparison: Picnic alternative divides planning and packing authority; raffle alternative assigns one controlled process with reporting limits.
seedUse: Raffle and deputy/co-organiser conflict derive from D49-a; S03 adds concrete ticket and money procedure instead of an abstract everything-delegated ending.
